boards.title: Your First Weekend at University of Evansville, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A first-weekend sequence of campus landmarks, a downtown outing, and a Sunday reset.

cards.title: Begin at Ridgway University Center
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · campus arrival
cards.notes: Start by checking the building directory and campus information nearby, then choose two practical landmarks to locate before you leave campus.
cards.short_summary: A central starting point for learning the campus layout.
cards.evidence_claim: Ridgway University Center is a named University of Evansville campus destination shown on the university’s official campus map.
cards.access_notes: Consult posted building-access information when you arrive.

cards.title: Walk over to Neu Chapel
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · campus landmark
cards.notes: Use the outdoor paths to reach this campus landmark, take a few orientation photos, and check public notices before planning a later visit.
cards.short_summary: A calm landmark stop on the first campus walk.
cards.evidence_claim: Neu Chapel and Wesley Gallery is a named destination on the University of Evansville official campus map.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor viewing is a flexible option; interior access depends on university scheduling.

cards.title: Locate Olmsted Administration Hall
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · academic bearings
cards.notes: Practice a route to this named campus destination and note nearby paths, so your first weekday class navigation feels less unfamiliar.
cards.short_summary: A route-finding stop for the coming academic week.
cards.evidence_claim: Olmsted Administration Hall is a named University of Evansville campus destination on the official campus map.
cards.access_notes: Use public campus paths and observe posted building-access rules.

cards.entity_name: Krannert Hall of Art and Music
cards.title: Check Krannert Hall of Art and Music
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · arts noticeboard
cards.notes: Pass by the building and look for university performance or exhibition information, then save any public dates you might want to attend.
cards.short_summary: A first look at a named campus arts destination.
cards.evidence_claim: Krannert Hall of Art and Music is a named University of Evansville campus destination on the official campus map.
cards.access_notes: Check event listings and posted access information for public programs.

cards.title: Find the Carson Center
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · recreation orientation
cards.notes: Locate the facility, review its posted program information, and choose one realistic time next week to return for campus recreation.
cards.short_summary: A campus waypoint for planning a future activity break.
cards.evidence_claim: Carson Center is a named University of Evansville campus destination shown on the official campus map.
cards.access_notes: Facility use and hours may be limited to eligible users and posted schedules.

cards.title: Spot the May Studio Theatre
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · theatre campus loop
cards.notes: Add this theatre destination to a short campus loop and check the current university arts calendar before making performance plans.
cards.short_summary: A named theatre venue to put on your campus map.
cards.evidence_claim: May Studio Theatre is a named University of Evansville campus destination on the official campus map.
cards.access_notes: Public attendance and access depend on the scheduled event; verify details before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Evansville Museum of Arts, History & Science
cards.title: Spend an afternoon at the Evansville Museum
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · downtown culture
cards.notes: Choose one gallery area before you go, allow time for the riverfront neighborhood, and confirm current visitor details directly with the museum.
cards.short_summary: A downtown museum outing spanning art, history, and science.
cards.evidence_claim: The Evansville Museum of Arts, History & Science presents collections and exhibitions in art, history, and science.
cards.source_title: Evansville Museum of Arts, History & Science
cards.access_notes: Review the museum’s current admission and visitor information before traveling there.

cards.title: Take a daylight Riverfront Park walk
cards.subtitle: Saturday late afternoon · outdoor reset
cards.notes: Walk the public riverfront paths with a friend, pause at the Ohio River overlook, and head back before dark if you are unfamiliar with downtown.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor downtown pause along the Ohio River.
cards.evidence_claim: Riverfront Park is an Evansville Parks and Recreation destination.
cards.access_notes: Use the park in daylight and follow current park rules and pedestrian signage.

cards.title: Reset at EVPL Central
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon · quiet downtown stop
cards.notes: Bring a reading task or local-events search, explore the library’s study spaces, and check its current schedule before building your afternoon around it.
cards.short_summary: A library-based Sunday pause before the new week.
cards.evidence_claim: EVPL Central provides study spaces, public computers, WiFi, and other resources at 200 S.E. Martin Luther King Jr. Boulevard.
cards.source_title: EVPL Central | Evansville Vanderburgh Public Library
cards.access_notes: The published hours list Sunday service from 1:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m.; confirm before visiting.

cards.title: Close at Bower-Suhrheinrich Library
cards.subtitle: Sunday evening · plan the week
cards.notes: End back on campus by locating the library and making a short list of research, reading, or study tasks to begin during your first week.
cards.short_summary: A final campus resource stop for easing into classes.
cards.evidence_claim: Bower-Suhrheinrich Library is a named University of Evansville campus destination on the official campus map.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current library access and service availability with the university.
